title: Finite-horizon perturbation response and training-activity structural predictors
scope: Exploratory follow-up; fixed before new scientific simulations; existing model and graphs unchanged
graph_independence: 15 conditional surrogates of one original; not 15 independent original networks

perturbation.timing: pre-step injection; state row n recorded at completed time (n+1)*0.1ms

model: Frozen placeholder current-like leaky integration; no new physical unit calibration or dt convergence claim
refractory: Pre-update until>slot gates membrane and channel decay; arriving inputs/field still accumulate. until=n+2 after spike skips only next slot.
new_observation_fields: 10 pre_refractory_until,11 actually_stepped,12 refractory_kernel_skipped,13 events_due_before_step; original ten fields preserved
training: Only old original/module_burst source counts; uncentered SVD; state scales also frozen on this old reference
primary_outcome: RMS of standardized [(graph perturbed - graph baseline) - (original perturbed - original baseline)], over slots200:1000, for each amplitude separately
other_outcomes: baseline graph trajectory error vs original
relative response fidelity using original response as denominator
source basis coverage on new original trajectory, never refit
recovery: After global response peak, earliest sample remaining below5%peak through end of recorded horizon with >=50 remaining slots. Otherwise right-censored. Zero responses separate. This is empirical window recovery, not an attractor/stability proof.
prediction_evaluation: 15 graph-level values per amplitude, original excluded; prespecified positive-direction Spearman; all points, within-arm n5, leave-one-arm-out n10 sensitivities; constant guard1e-12. No p-values, no refitting, no choosing successful ranks after test.
predeclared_failures: new input activity largely outside frozen U
small perturbation is gated or generates no spike response
small own response but poor original-response fidelity
technical_gates: first300slot bridge to old module reference
all48 finite states and within-chunk equality
preperturbation exact bitwise identity to own baseline
refractory and actual execution flags independently checked
preprint_action: No manuscript changes in this experiment
